revision_reason: Before v2 runs, correct a clerical Planner policy snapshot error found by comparing both frozen baseline tasks and the invalid candidate smoke. v1 recorded a different role snapshot even though baseline and candidate both used the same current Planner policy.

invalid_v1_runs.reason: v1 identity mismatch; cancelled at the frozen stop boundary while Browser remained on Baidu AI-summary results

candidate_identity_rule: Before any candidate device run, record the exact candidate decision_context.py digest. Planner policy, tools, schemas, other roles, Skills, observation, state, and actions must remain byte-identical to baseline.

cases.precondition: Browser is foreground on a retained Example Domain result or search surface; no login or download dialog is open.
cases.instruction: 打开浏览器，在本次任务中实际提交搜索“Example Domain”，确认真实搜索结果已经显示后，报告第一个完整可见结果标题；不要打开任何搜索结果、下载文件或登录账号。
acceptance: A task-local exact-query search is submitted once and the first complete visible title is reported without opening it.
Every exposed recovery Planner request contains active_action_timeline and omits last_reviewed_subgoal.
No download, login, or unsafe side effect occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, result opening, download/login side effect, safety violation, or 14 outer steps.

cases.precondition: AMap is foreground on home/search/retained route state with location available; navigation has not started and no blocking dialog is open.
cases.instruction: 打开高德地图，搜索北京南站，进入从当前位置出发的驾车路线预览；确认路线和预计时间已经加载后停留，不要开始导航。
acceptance: The final driving preview targets 北京南站 and visibly shows route/time information.
Every exposed recovery Planner request contains active_action_timeline and omits last_reviewed_subgoal.
Navigation, ride-hail, call, order, and payment are not started.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, navigation start, prohibited action, safety violation, or 25 outer steps.

cases.precondition: Calculator can be launched and shows any non-error ordinary display; history/scientific panels are closed.
cases.instruction: 打开计算器，先计算23×17；确认中间结果显示391后，再在该结果上加9；确认最终结果显示400后，报告400。不要清空后直接输入400，不要打开历史记录或科学计算器。
acceptance: Task-local actions establish 23×17=391 before +9=400 in the requested order.
The final visible result and reported answer are 400; direct entry of 400 is a false-success.
No history/scientific panel or unsafe side effect occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, direct entry of 400, wrong committed result, safety violation, or 18 outer steps.

admission_rule: Admit only if all valid candidate runs are true-success with zero safety violations, the Calculator ordered-stage control does not regress, every candidate recovery exposure removes the duplicate field while retaining required context, and exposed recovery-anchor tokens decrease without worse repeated/wrong-action behavior. A run without the candidate path is a control and cannot prove causal benefit. This is not a global 95/5 claim.
